R5. Gross monthly income (earned plus unearned) may not exceed $1,729 for a 1-person household plus $616 for each additional member, which is 130% of the poverty line.
R6. The household must live in the state where it applies.
R7. No member may be serving a disqualification for an intentional program violation.
R8. Countable resources may not exceed $3,000, or $4,750 if a member is 60 or older or disabled, unless the household receives TANF cash assistance or SSI.
R9. If no member's age or disability is given, assume no member is 60 or older or disabled.

Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP): household eligibility rules, fiscal year 2027
A household is approved only if it meets every rule below. Income figures are monthly. Rules marked as defaults say what to assume when the application is silent on a point.

R1. If the application does not mention college enrollment, assume no member is a college student.
R2. Gross monthly income (earned plus unearned) may not exceed $1,729 for a 1-person household plus $616 for each additional member, which is 130% of the poverty line, unless a member is aged 60 or older or disabled.
R3. No member may be a fleeing felon or a parole violator.
R4. The household is not eligible if a member quit a job in the past 30 days, unless the member left the job for good cause, such as discrimination, a required move, or caring for a family member.
R5. Unless the household receives TANF cash assistance or SSI, net monthly income may not exceed $1,330 for a 1-person household plus $474 for each additional member. Net income is gross income minus 20% of earned income, minus a standard deduction ($217 for 1 to 3 members, $229 for 4, $268 for 5, $308 for 6), minus shelter costs above half of the income left after those deductions (that shelter deduction is capped at $769 unless a member is 60 or older or disabled).
R6. The household must live in the state where it applies.
R7. A member aged 18 to 49 enrolled at least half-time in college is not eligible, unless the student works at least 20 hours a week.
R8. If the application does not show TANF or SSI, treat the household as not receiving either.

Case file:
Case file 8456 was opened for Ahmed Hassan this month. A household member dedicates their free time to volunteering at the community food pantry. Liquid assets including bank balances, stocks, and bonds total $4,900 in liquid holdings. Official documentation confirms citizenship in a Compact of Free Association jurisdiction such as the Marshall Islands, Micronesia, or Palau. Employment history confirms a verified total of 40 qualifying work quarters. Valid Social Security numbers are officially registered for all household members. No member is a fleeing felon or violating parole. Income calculation yields $3,203 following the subtraction of earned income and standard deductions. Submitted employment documentation indicates monthly wage earnings of $2,400. Assistance benefits and support payments contribute $1,500 in monthly unearned revenue. Administrative records note a current program disqualification resulting from a prior intentional violation. No individual in the dwelling is classified as an able-bodied adult without dependents. Supplemental Security Income benefits are received by every individual residing in the home. The final calculated net monthly income stands at $3,203 after all applicable deductions. Labor stoppage participation is currently underway for one wage earner at the manufacturing plant. Housing expenses fall short of half the adjusted income threshold by a variance of $-1,001. Combined monthly expenses for rent and utility services amount to $600. The sum of earned wages and unearned funds establishes a gross monthly income of $3,900. The household has no member aged 18 to 49 enrolled at least half-time in college. The adult recipient received 1 month of benefits over the prior 36 months without fulfilling standard work obligations. Financial eligibility was not met prior to the labor strike due to elevated income levels. Work history shows no member quit a job in the past 30 days. Qualifying disability benefits are currently distributed to a member of the residence. Permanent residency is maintained within the boundaries of the filing state. Verification shows 0 monthly hours dedicated to employment or vocational training activities for that adult. The reviewing officer documented that the applicant exhibited exemplary cooperation and thorough preparation. A domestic unit of 2 individuals shares a common living space and prepares meals together.
